All-dimensional reasoning is not inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: The coefficientwise face-polynomial for a natural homogeneous two-orbit concept system is determined at every dimension, including a sharp and geometrically motivated Lagrangian obstruction to odd Arf parity. The two classes have the same scalar VC dimension in every rank at least two but differ at precisely one enumerated degree, which is not a mere restatement of classical Gauss sums or isotropic-subspace counts. The exact support criterion supplies potential input to subsequent structure and learning questions without asserting a new downstream theorem.
